targets.rawSql:
WITH time_bounds AS (
  SELECT 
    COALESCE(GREATEST($__timeFrom()::timestamptz, MIN(timestamp)), $__timeFrom()::timestamptz) AS range_start,
    COALESCE(LEAST($__timeTo()::timestamptz, MAX(timestamp)), $__timeTo()::timestamptz) AS range_end
  FROM public.fact_system_hardware
  WHERE timestamp >= $__timeFrom()::timestamptz
    AND timestamp <= $__timeTo()::timestamptz
),
time_grid AS (
  SELECT generate_series(
    b.range_start,
    b.range_end,
    GREATEST(interval '3 seconds', ('$__interval')::interval)
  ) AS grid_time
  FROM time_bounds b
)
SELECT 
  g.grid_time AS "time",
  AVG(hw.cpu_package_temp) AS "CPU 封装温度",
  AVG(hw.cpu_package_power) AS "CPU 封装功率"
FROM time_grid g
LEFT JOIN public.fact_system_hardware hw ON hw.timestamp >= g.grid_time 
  AND hw.timestamp < g.grid_time + GREATEST(interval '3 seconds', ('$__interval')::interval)
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 1;

panels.title: 用户态调度抖动与上下文切换压力

targets.rawSql:
WITH daily_metrics AS (
  SELECT 
    timestamp,
    date_trunc('$aging_step', timestamp) AS period,
    cpu_package_power,
    cpu_package_temp,
    cpu_clock_mhz,
    cpu_vcore_voltage,
    MAX(cpu_package_power) OVER(PARTITION BY date_trunc('$aging_step', timestamp)) AS max_cpu_pwr
  FROM public.fact_system_hardware
  WHERE timestamp >= now() - interval '$aging_window'
    AND timestamp <= now()
)
SELECT 
  period AS "time",
  AVG(CASE WHEN max_cpu_pwr > ${cpu_min_watt} AND cpu_package_power >= ${aging_load_ratio} * max_cpu_pwr THEN cpu_package_temp ELSE NULL END) AS "CPU 负载温度",
  AVG(CASE WHEN max_cpu_pwr > ${cpu_min_watt} AND cpu_package_power >= ${aging_load_ratio} * max_cpu_pwr THEN cpu_package_power ELSE NULL END) AS "CPU 负载功率",
  AVG(CASE WHEN max_cpu_pwr > ${cpu_min_watt} AND cpu_package_power >= ${aging_load_ratio} * max_cpu_pwr THEN cpu_clock_mhz ELSE NULL END) AS "CPU 负载主频",
  AVG(CASE WHEN max_cpu_pwr > ${cpu_min_watt} AND cpu_package_power >= ${aging_load_ratio} * max_cpu_pwr THEN cpu_vcore_voltage ELSE NULL END) AS "CPU 负载电压"
FROM daily_metrics
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 1;
